title: Idea Spark Award
content: Awarded the prestigious Idea Spark Award at INNOCLASH 2026 for outstanding core innovation in the accident detection logic of ResQNet.

title: 2nd Place at Apple-X-Fest
content: Secured 2nd place for the technical development of ResQNet, a road safety system that detects accidents and alerts emergency contacts.

title: Inter-college Runner-up
content: Earned runner-up honors for Lifebite, an AI-enabled food donation platform that connects donors with NGOs to reduce food wastage.

title: Google Solution Challenge & SIH
content: Submitted Vayal-AI to the Google Solution Challenge 2025 and was selected in the Smart India Hackathon (SIH) Internals.
